title: Peace & Rest
intro: Teenagers are tired in a way that is not always about sleep. Between the noise, the pressure and a phone that never finishes, rest has become something they have to be given permission for. This month gives it — plainly, without making rest another thing to be good at.

keyScriptures.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest... my yoke is easy and my burden is light.
You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

weeks.title: Rest Is Not Earned
weeks.declaration: Rest is not the reward for having finished. It was built into the week before anyone had achieved anything, and it is available to you unfinished.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, break the belief in our child that rest must be deserved. Let them stop without guilt. Amen.

weeks.title: Where the Weight Goes
weeks.declaration: You are carrying things that were never assigned to you. There is somewhere to put them down, and doing so is not irresponsible.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, take from our child what is too heavy and not theirs. Show us what we have added. Amen.

weeks.title: Quiet Is a Skill
weeks.declaration: Silence is uncomfortable at first because you are not used to it. It is a skill, and it is worth acquiring before you need it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, give our child a taste for quiet. Let them be able to sit with their own thoughts. Amen.

weeks.title: Peace That Does Not Depend on Circumstances
weeks.declaration: The peace on offer is not the absence of pressure. It is steadiness inside the pressure, which is the only kind that would be any use.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give our child a peace that holds when nothing is resolved. Amen.

days.title: Not Earned
days.declaration: Rest is not a reward for finishing. It was built into the week before anyone had achieved anything.

scripture.text: By the seventh day God had finished the work... and he rested.

days.title: Come as You Are
days.declaration: The invitation is to the weary, not to the sorted. You do not have to tidy yourself up first.

scripture.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

days.title: Tired Is Not Only Sleep
days.declaration: Some tiredness is not fixed by sleeping. Noise, pressure and comparison exhaust you differently.

scripture.text: He refreshes my soul.

days.title: Set the Weight Down
days.declaration: You are carrying things that were never assigned to you. Putting them down is not irresponsible.

scripture.text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

days.title: The Phone Never Finishes
days.declaration: There is no bottom to the feed. Nothing will tell you when to stop, so you have to decide it yourself.

scripture.text: I have the right to do anything, but I will not be mastered by anything.

days.title: Sleep Is Not Weakness
days.declaration: Sleep is not lost time or lack of ambition. It is maintenance on the only body you were issued.

scripture.text: In vain you rise early and stay up late... for he grants sleep to those he loves.

days.title: Quiet Is a Skill
days.declaration: Silence is uncomfortable because you are out of practice. It is worth learning before you need it.

scripture.text: Be still, and know that I am God.

days.title: Worry Is Not Preparation
days.declaration: Worrying feels like doing something about tomorrow. It is not, and it charges you for the privilege.

scripture.text: Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life?

days.title: One Day's Worth
days.declaration: Today has enough in it. You are not required to carry next year this evening.

scripture.text: Do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself.

days.title: Peace That Guards
days.declaration: God's peace does not explain the situation. It stands guard over your mind while it stays unresolved.

scripture.text: The peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds.

days.title: Busy Is Not Important
days.declaration: Busyness is not evidence of a life that matters. It is often evidence of not having chosen.

scripture.text: You are worried and upset about many things, but few things are needed.

days.title: Say It Out Loud
days.declaration: An anxiety said out loud to a person loses a surprising amount of its size.

scripture.text: Anxiety weighs down the heart, but a kind word cheers it up.

days.title: Not in Charge of Everything
days.declaration: Some things are genuinely not yours to fix. Handing those back is maturity, not indifference.

scripture.text: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you.

days.title: Rest Before Empty
days.declaration: Rest before you have run out rather than after. Recovery is far more expensive than maintenance.

scripture.text: Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest.

days.title: Stillness Is Not Laziness
days.declaration: Sitting still with God is not wasted time. It is where a great deal of the actual work gets done.

scripture.text: Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from him.

days.title: Perfectionism Is Not a Virtue
days.declaration: Perfectionism is not high standards. It is fear wearing a respectable coat, and it will not let you rest.

scripture.text: Do not be overrighteous, neither be overwise — why destroy yourself?

days.title: You Do Not Have to Perform Here
days.declaration: Home is meant to be a place where you can be unimpressive. You do not have to be on.

scripture.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

days.title: A Whisper, Not a Shout
days.declaration: God rarely competes with the noise. That is a practical argument for turning some of it down.

scripture.text: And after the fire came a gentle whisper.

days.title: Nothing to Prove
days.declaration: You do not have to earn your place by being productive. It was given, and it is not on review.

scripture.text: It is by grace you have been saved, through faith... not by works.

days.title: Slow Is Not Behind
days.declaration: Slowing down is not falling behind. Most things worth having are built at walking pace.

scripture.text: In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength.

days.title: Rest for Your Mind
days.declaration: Your mind needs rest as much as your body, and it does not get it from a different screen.

scripture.text: Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

days.title: Not Everything Is Urgent
days.declaration: Almost nothing is genuinely urgent. Learning that distinction will calm your whole decade.

scripture.text: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity.

days.title: Peace With People
days.declaration: Part of your peace depends on unresolved things with people. Do your half and let the rest be theirs.

scripture.text: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

days.title: The Weight You Were Not Given
days.declaration: If it feels crushing, check whether it was ever yours. His yoke is described as light for a reason.

scripture.text: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.

days.title: Unfinished Is Allowed
days.declaration: You will go to bed with things unfinished. That is a normal life, not a failed day.

scripture.text: His mercies... are new every morning.

days.title: Rhythm, Not Collapse
days.declaration: Aim for a rhythm of work and rest rather than sprinting until you break. The second is not more dedicated.

scripture.text: Six days you shall labour... but the seventh day is a sabbath.

days.title: Play Is Not Childish
days.declaration: Doing something purely because you enjoy it is not immature. It is part of being a person.

scripture.text: The city streets will be filled with boys and girls playing.

days.title: God Is Not Rushing You
days.declaration: God is not impatient with how long you are taking. The urgency you feel is usually not from Him.

scripture.text: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years... he is patient with you.

days.title: Breathe and Say One Word
days.declaration: When it is all too much, breathe slowly and say one word to God. That counts as prayer.

scripture.text: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

days.title: Kept in Perfect Peace
days.declaration: There is a steadiness available that does not depend on anything being resolved. It comes from where your mind rests.

scripture.text: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

days.title: Keep the Quiet
days.declaration: The quiet you have practised this month is meant for the loud months. Keep it.

scripture.text: He leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul.
